name: plugin-test-scaffold
description: Generate PHPUnit test infrastructure and initial tests for an Elgg plugin after migration

plugin_path.description: Absolute path to the plugin directory

docker_container.description: Docker container name for running tests

steps.title: Scan plugin for testable features
steps.description: Read elgg-plugin.php, all classes, actions, views. Catalog: entity types, actions, hooks/events, routes, permissions hooks. Create a test plan listing what to test.

steps.title: Create test directory structure
steps.description: Create: tests/phpunit.xml, tests/phpunit/integration/<Namespace>/. Use the template from elgg-test-writer skill. The phpunit.xml must reference the Elgg test bootstrap.

steps.title: Write entity class and CRUD tests
steps.description: For each entity type in elgg-plugin.php 'entities' key: test class mapping (createObject + get_entity returns correct class), test save/delete lifecycle, test custom methods. Use $this->createObject(['subtype' => '...']).

steps.title: Write action tests
steps.description: For each action in elgg-plugin.php 'actions' key: test with valid input (expect success), test with missing required input (expect error), test permission check (non-owner gets 403). Use $this->executeAction('action/name', [...]).

steps.title: Write hook/event handler tests
steps.description: For each hook/event registered in elgg-plugin.php or Bootstrap: test that the handler executes without errors when triggered with valid input. For menu hooks, verify menu items are added. For permission hooks, verify access control.

steps.title: Write view render tests
steps.description: For key views (resource views, entity views, form views): test that elgg_view() returns non-empty output without PHP errors. Focus on views that have complex logic or use plugin-specific variables.

steps.title: Run tests in Docker and fix failures
steps.description: Copy plugin to Docker container, run phpunit. Fix any failures. Iterate until all tests pass. Command: docker exec <container> php /var/www/html/vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration /var/www/html/mod/<plugin-id>/tests/phpunit.xml

steps.title: Commit test suite
steps.description: git add tests/ && git commit -m 'test: add integration tests for <plugin>'. Then close the pre-migration test beads issue if one exists. Verify that closing it unblocks the first migration step in the dependency chain.
